title: The rematch
goals: Fly through the eight rings in order.
starting_code:
# This is the program that won the race, and Zarek has moved the rings.
def two_rings(first, second):
    wizard.move_down(2)
    wizard.move_right(first)
    wizard.move_up(2)
    wizard.move_right(second)

wizard.cast("drevo")
wizard.move_right(2)
two_rings(3, 2)
two_rings(3, 2)
two_rings(2, 3)
two_rings(2, 2)
hints: Look at the rings closely. They are no longer in the same places!
Do not add any new lines, or your program will take off too late. Just change the numbers.
Change the calls so the stretches are 2 and 3, 2 and 3, 3 and 2, and 2 and 2.
intro: Zarek wants a rematch! He has moved the rings and flies more neatly: his program has 12 lines. A tie is still Zarek's! Here is the program that won the race. Not a single line may be added or you will take off late, but you only need to change the numbers in your calls.
outro: Zarek lands beside you, and the class cheers from the stand. You flew beautifully, {wizard}!
